Name: Ithream, Son of David
Summary: Sixth son of David, born in Hebron to Eglah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 3:3: Sixth son of David, born in Hebron to Eglah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ithream stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
